reason: Use Tier 2: replace final-query sampled-softmax supervision with a top-10-weighted pairwise ranking loss. The supplied trajectory shows incremental recovery from consistency and history exclusions to 0.5637, still below 0.5800, while convolution and view separation failed to improve the best result. This motivates testing objective alignment: sampled-softmax classification does not explicitly prioritize the ranking errors that determine HR@10; the proposed change is distinct from the supplied attempts.

plan.model_design: Make one controlled objective change: replace only the clean final-query cross-entropy with a LambdaRank-style top-10-weighted pairwise logistic loss, preserving the existing masked transformer. For each row, rank the positive and eligible sampled negatives using detached logits; define D(r)=1/log2(r+2) for zero-based ranks below 10 and zero otherwise, then weight softplus(negative_logit-positive_logit) by abs(D(positive_rank)-D(negative_rank)). Normalize by the sum of eligible pair weights per row and average over rows, using a differentiable zero contribution when no eligible negatives exist. This emphasizes mistakes involving the top-10 boundary while retaining historical reconstruction cross-entropy, consistency regularization, tied item_emb, jointly trained item_bias, and the existing supervised loss coefficients. Preserve MaskedSASRec, its constructor, forward(self, sequence), predict(self, sequence, candidates), and all inference scores.
plan.training_evaluation: In train_one, compute the replacement final_loss from the existing clean-query logits and unchanged 256 shared uniform negative draws; remove history-excluded and target-colliding negatives before assigning ranks or pair weights. Keep auxiliary reconstruction, consistency, sampling, optimizer, hyperparameters, seed 42, supplied splits, checkpoint selection, and stopping rules unchanged to isolate this objective experiment. Add RNG-preserving checks that excluded negatives have zero gradient, an incorrectly high eligible negative receives a downward update, and rows without eligible negatives remain finite; verify exported-predictor parity after strict checkpoint reload. Preserve evaluate, prediction_sequence, write_predict_script, and predict(user_id, history, candidates, *, dataset_name=None), with exactly one independently trained selected checkpoint for each of the four categories. Retain DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, single-GPU execution, fixed validation with 200 users per category and 99 unique negatives at seed 42, and the final measured macro HR@10 log line; leave hidden-test inference to the host and compare authoritative validation against both 0.5637 and 0.5800.
